purpose: Test whether a compact reserve of token IDs actually selected by the frozen full-vocabulary LayerCake host on train-split long-form prompts restores parent-like UTF-8 token efficiency without widening every decoding step.

triggering_evidence.decision: The deterministic ascending expansion branch is closed because 6,723 extra base IDs did not materially reduce generated-token count and made per-step execution slower.

calibration.selection_order: ascending SHA-256 of UTF-8 row id, then prompt SHA-256
calibration.prompt_transform: Append exactly: ' Continue for at least 220 words so sustained decoding can be measured.'
calibration.runtime_decoding: unchanged deterministic greedy with the sealed repetition controls
calibration.skip_rule: Skip and record a row only if the transformed prompt activates a fixed symbolic handler or cannot reach 1,024 bytes inside the context boundary.
calibration.allowed_payload: Authoritative generated token IDs from the frozen LayerCake host; no logits, activations, new weights, validation outputs, benchmark outputs, or source-teacher payload.

nested_budgets.construction: Union the locked 1,469 train-output IDs with every authoritative output token ID selected on the first 32 eligible hash-ordered train prompts.
Union the previous budget with every authoritative output token ID selected on the first 128 eligible hash-ordered train prompts.

speed_pass: median throughput ratio to Qwen at least 2.0
paired-prompt bootstrap 95 percent lower bound at least 2.0
at least 95 percent sealed Phase 2 parent median throughput
all TTFT, RSS, active-memory, persistent-state, UTF-8, and collapse gates pass
execution_and_stop_rule.after_speed_pass: Run all 1,400 ABI validation rows, all 420/43,089 general-English validation rows, the 120-observation headline benchmark, physical proof, and identity on that exact artifact.
execution_and_stop_rule.early_stop: Stop at the first nested budget passing sustained and every repeated promotion gate.
execution_and_stop_rule.failure: If train_longform_128 fails sustained speed, close this architecture and retain all negative evidence before testing a different measured architecture.

claim_boundary: This procedure selects a compact tested token reserve, not a globally minimum vocabulary. Promotion still requires the exact same final teacher-free host to pass every locked quality, identity, physical sparsity, speed, TTFT, RSS, collapse, and three-seed gate.
